rules: A package imports only what `mayImport` lists (LR-1).
A package marked `core` names no implementation of an extension point and no sample (F100-FR-012).

A package marked `core` does not import node:fs or node:fs/promises; it reads and writes files through the kernel and through the ports of the edge packages (F100-FR-012, F100-FR-234; assumption: CQ-185).
No package but @specstride/runtime and @specstride/cli is a composition root.
The pi harness adapter imports the JSONL reader from the package of the prime harness adapter, or both import it from @specstride/harness; feature 138 decides and the graph follows.

A core package receives the kernel services of annex A §A.3 (the process primitive, the clock, the registration call of the doctor's checks, the atomic write) as arguments from the composition root, and never reads them from a module of the platform (F100-FR-234; the interface types are packages/contracts/src/ep/kernel-services.ts).

A core package reaches an edge package (the three marked `edge`: @specstride/integrity, owner 116; @specstride/tree-store, owner 143; @specstride/check-runner, owner 148) only through its interface in @specstride/contracts, never by importing it; an edge package may touch the file system or start a process on behalf of a core package (F100-FR-234).

The calls of the engine into learning are a plain function interface of @specstride/contracts at layer L2, which the composition root hands to the engine; it is no extension point in Wave 1 and a failure of a call leaves the run on the value it would have had without learning (F100-FR-235).
